differences.reason: This complete GP3 record retains explicit tempo events in Song.TempoAutomations and the opening tempo separately in Song.InitialTempo. The pinned binary consumer inserts two initial 120 BPM events at bar 0 among its master-bar event list, shifting these exact compared positions. Raw event and GP8 consumer evidence is in TestAlphaTabMixTableProjection; the remaining timing criterion is tracked in issue 85.
